provenance.canonical-source: apps/v4/registry/new-york-v4/ui/dropdown-menu.tsx — 15 exported parts, every one a thin data-slot wrapper around the external, unvendored `radix-ui` package's DropdownMenu primitive (package.json:80 `"radix-ui": "^1.4.3"`, no node_modules/radix-ui anywhere in this clone). Every STYLE value below comes from this file's own literal className strings, which ARE real, committed source even though the code that sets the data-state/data-highlighted attributes those classes key off lives externally. See DROPDOWN-MENU-MATRIX.md §0.
provenance.trigger-is-unstyled: DropdownMenuTrigger's entire body is `<DropdownMenuPrimitive.Trigger data-slot="dropdown-menu-trigger" {...props} />` — no className, no style props, nothing. Every style.trigger.* row is therefore a CONFIRMED, sourced absence for this column, not a research gap — see finding 2.
provenance.popup-bg / popup-fg: DropdownMenuContent: `bg-popover text-popover-foreground` -> --popover/--popover-foreground (globals.css:105-106 light, :148-149 dark). Reused verbatim from select.shadcn.json's own identical slots.
provenance.popup-border: DropdownMenuContent's bare `border` utility, no colour class -> --border (globals.css:117/:160).
provenance.popup-shadow: DropdownMenuContent class `shadow-md`. [R] — Tailwind's documented default two-layer value; radix-ui is not vendored in this clone. Reused verbatim from select.shadcn.json's own popup-shadow (the first shadow-md this registry needed).
provenance.popup-gap: CONFIRMED OFF — no gap utility anywhere on DropdownMenuContent; items sit flush against each other inside the p-1 padding.
provenance.item-bg-hover / item-fg-hover: DropdownMenuItem: `focus:bg-accent focus:text-accent-foreground` -> --accent/--accent-foreground (globals.css:113-114/:156-157). Reached through :focus, not :hover — Radix moves real DOM focus onto the item on pointermove/arrow-keys, the same mechanism select.shadcn.json's own accent-bg/-fg already documented.
provenance.item-fg: DropdownMenuItem sets no own text-colour class at rest — the item inherits --popover-foreground from the popup ambient colour (see popup-fg); not re-slotted.
provenance.item-padding / item-gap / item-shape: DropdownMenuItem class `flex items-center gap-2 rounded-sm px-2 py-1.5 text-sm` -> gap-2=8px, rounded-sm -> --radius-sm = calc(var(--radius)*0.6) = 6px (globals.css:50), px-2 py-1.5 = 8px/6px.
provenance.item-min-height: CONFIRMED OFF — content-driven, no min-height/height utility anywhere on DropdownMenuItem.
provenance.danger / danger-bg-hover: DropdownMenuItem's `variant="destructive"` branch: `data-[variant=destructive]:text-destructive data-[variant=destructive]:focus:bg-destructive/10 dark:data-[variant=destructive]:focus:bg-destructive/20` -> --destructive (globals.css:115/:158, the SAME value select.shadcn.json's own 'danger' slot already resolved) at two DIFFERENT alpha stops per mode (10% light / 20% dark — a real, sourced, mode-specific asymmetry, not a copy-paste of one alpha into both modes). Tailwind v4 compiles the /N modifier on an oklch custom property to color-mix(in oklab, var(--x) N%, transparent), the same derivation select.shadcn.json's own dark field-bg already used.
provenance.fg-muted: --muted-foreground (globals.css:112/:155). THREE consumers: item icons (`[&_svg:not([class*='text-'])]:text-muted-foreground`), DropdownMenuShortcut (`text-muted-foreground`), and item-icon sizing's colour partner.
provenance.icon-size: class `[&_svg:not([class*='size-'])]:size-4` = 16px, the generic descendant-selector sizing rule for any un-annotated child svg (informal mechanism — see structure.item-icon).
provenance.shortcut-type: DropdownMenuShortcut class `ml-auto text-xs tracking-widest text-muted-foreground` -> text-xs = 0.75rem/1rem, tracking-widest is a letter-spacing utility not modelled as a separate row (folded into the type shorthand's own font-family string is inaccurate for tracking, but this column's own type rows do not carry a tracking channel elsewhere either — declared simplification, consistent with the rest of this pipeline's shadcn columns).
provenance.group-label-no-color: DropdownMenuLabel class `px-2 py-1.5 text-sm font-medium data-[inset]:pl-8` — NO text-muted-foreground or any other colour class. A real, sourced CONTRAST with select.shadcn.json's own SelectLabel (which DOES carry text-muted-foreground): this dropdown-menu's label inherits the ambient popover-foreground and is distinguished ONLY by font-medium weight, not colour.
provenance.separator: DropdownMenuSeparator class `-mx-1 my-1 h-px bg-border` -> --border, my-1=4px vertical margin, -mx-1=-4px horizontal (bleeds the line to the popup's own edge past its p-1 padding), h-px=1px height.
provenance.submenu-trigger-open: DropdownMenuSubTrigger class `data-[state=open]:bg-accent data-[state=open]:text-accent-foreground` — the SAME slot as plain item hover, not a distinct 'open' colour.
